intro: Parts and Pieces is a retrieval quest offered by Wrenix the Wretched in the port town of Ratchet. After several mercenaries failed to survive encounters with the local pirates, Wrenix deployed a mechanical contraption to handle the threat, only for the raiders to dismantle it into scrap. Adventurers are tasked with heading to the pirates' upper camp to recover the scattered machinery before further harm is done.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!
I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.
Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
